## B-344-2 — stale active card still gives false cancellation consent

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:218-237,304-311,363-375` keeps End my plan actionable after a failed refresh and branches consent solely on the cached `plan.state`. A cached active plan gets “Your plan stays active until November 2, 2026…” with no immediate-ending qualification, even though its current server state can have entered dunning. [Exact panel](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx).

**Counterexample:** load active plan → next list read fails → stale banner appears → choose End my plan; the real alert still unconditionally promises period-end access. The paired server branches on current delinquency, not that stale active card, and can void the unpaid invoice/end access now. The probe fails on the exact unconditional consent text; fixing just the cached past_due branch did not repair this case. [Executed consent probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37234565354), [paired cancellation contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/689).

**Minimal fix:** active/trialing consent must truthfully cover the current-state race: if an unpaid delinquent period is now present, ending voids that unpaid charge and ends access now; otherwise access lasts through the paid period. Alternatively require a working authoritative refresh before acting on a stale card, but still make the consent race-safe. Retain the repaired past_due→paid-meanwhile qualification and canonical outcome display. Verify stale-active/trialing→dunning as well as the existing voluntary/past_due/paid-meanwhile controls. [Affected implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx), [current controls and failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37234565354).

## B-344-3 — old cancellation receipt overrides a newer authoritative renewing plan

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:142-148,182-185,316-333` stores a cancellation outcome string separately from the plan and always prefers it over current plan data. Successful reads update plans/list but never reconcile that outcome, except parent reloadKey changes or a local resume. [Exact authority boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx).

**Counterexample:** cancel returns scheduled → immediate list reload fails → another session successfully keeps the same plan → Try again returns canonical active, cancelAtPeriodEnd=false, next charge $99 on November 2. The stale warning disappears and End my plan returns, but the card still says “Your plan is ended … nothing more is charged.” The failed assertion receives that old cancellation sentence instead of Next charge. [Executed real-panel authority probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37234565354).

**Minimal fix:** attach receipt provenance/structured outcome and reconcile it against each successful authoritative view; keep the receipt while refresh is unavailable, but never present it as current state when a newer view contradicts it. Historical action confirmation may remain separately labeled. Retain ended/voided-amount outcomes, canonical resume response and read-generation protection. Verify cancel→failed reload→remote resume→successful retry, plus the immediate failed-reload and local-resume controls. [Affected panel](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx), [two passing controls plus failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37234565354).

## Optional Cs — freeze/ticket

- **C-344-1, carried native composition:** `src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:257-272` still carries hosted-portal Update card; final lockout composition must keep the native Update card screen and name the actual action in Your plans. [Prior Sol finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5982674874), [exact screen](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx).
- **C-344-12, neutral no-answer diagnosis:** `src/lib/planActions.ts:98-99,161-162,231,237-238` treats any no-status exception as unreachable/offline; a timeout or nontransport exception proves only no answer. Use neutral wording and sanitized unknown reporting, keeping refresh/support. [Exact mapper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/lib/planActions.ts).
- **C-344-13, setup-unavailable capability guidance:** `src/lib/planActions.ts:186-195` maps resume's known preflight SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE refusal as “not confirmed yet.” Give it specific capability/unchanged guidance with coach/support action rather than generic uncertainty. [Exact mapper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7e17d142d45cfcf6d922b6e78f79881be2428041/src/lib/planActions.ts), [acknowledged builder follow-up](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5984026424).

Other-lens C-344-5/6/8/9/10/11 remain operator follow-ups (share terms, CTA a11y label, Keep amount/date, privacy/first-person copy, trial fixture time, share-token analytics), not duplicate additions to this Sol count. [Prior inventory](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5982759668).

[Authority lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37234565354), [ordinary CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37233295816), [size/restack](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5984292690). Mocked transport/native providers do not prove live Stripe or native-device acceptance; no local heavy work, merge or deployment is claimed. [Executed tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37234402193).

**Default:** keep the truthful current-production “message your coach” fallback, repair only these two B mechanisms, retain all prior probes and ticket Cs; then obtain fresh dual exact-head verdicts and land P1–P3 as one with final-main Analyze, recurring backend deployment, dunning D4 #690 and native card-update composition. [Current production fallback/fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5984026424), [landing proposal](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5984292690).

**Cross-lane, report-only:** dispute-pause ends entitlement while retaining subscription status, but recurring planView can still call that row confirming; mobile cannot infer a dispute from that shape. Route the authoritative pause-state contract to recurring/dunning, then propagate through mobile; integrated copy must say access ended, billing paused, coach decides whether to restart, never automatic restoration or “within a minute.” This is another PR's owned contract gap, not a third B assigned here. Default: resolve before integrated release. [Recurring owner](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/679), [dispute-pause owner](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/705).
